product_metadata.title: Maytex Super Heavyweight Premium 10-Gauge Shower Liner or Curtain with Rustproof Metal Grommets, White, 72 x 72 Inches
features: PREMIUM 10-GAUGE SHOWER LINER OR CURTAIN: Super heavyweight shower liner or curtain is made of premium 10-gauge vinyl for long-lasting durability
FITS STANDARD SHOWERS AND BATHTUBS: Sized at 72 in. by 72 in. to fit all standard shower spaces and bathtubs
NO MAGNETS NEEDED: Heavy duty construction keeps the shower curtain liner close to your shower walls so water stays in and drafts stay out
REINFORCED HEADER WITH RUSTPROOF METAL GROMMETS: Features a reinforced mesh header and 12 rustproof metal grommets that work with shower hooks or rings and prevent tearing
EASY TO KEEP CLEAN: Just wipe with a damp cloth to keep clean and looking like new

IT'S EASY TO ELIMINATE THAT NEW LINER SMELL: All PVC shower liners have an inherent mild scent when new. To eliminate this smell, simply rinse your new liner, wash with mild soap and water, and allow it to air dry before using for the first time
description: Offering superior durability, the Maytex Super Heavyweight Premium 10-Gauge Shower Liner or Curtain is able to be used on its own or combined with your favorite fabric shower curtain. The heavyweight shower curtain liner features a reinforced mesh header with rustproof metal grommets for easy hanging with your choice of shower hooks or rings. The heavy duty shower liner's weight keeps it close to the walls of your tub to prevent drafts. The shower liner has a white finish to create privacy. For easy care, just wipe the liner clean with a damp cloth. We recommend fully opening the liner to dry after each use. It measures 72 by 72 inches to fit standard shower and tub areas. Rings not included.
